resolution: Fixed 'I walk through hotel/motel walls in /test' — a SCALE limit, not a per-wall bug. Headless dump of the user's real map: 2927 wall-family pieces (all with collision tag, all quarter-yaw) → placedPieceColliders emits 4928 rects, but the host rect cap was 4096 (framework/game/physics.zig MAX_RECTS + cart/hmsc-int/game/physics.ts PHYSICS_LIMITS.rects, mirrored). GAME_WORLD.collisionRects drops the overflow in layer order, so the tail — the most recently built structure (wall.stucco.motel ×55, the 'hotel') — silently lost its colliders and became walk-through ('it wasnt long ago' = the map just crossed 4096). Raised the cap to 16384 in both the Zig host and the TS mirror. Only one static buffer scales with it (g_camera_occlusion_rect_values, ~720KB at 16384); per-step cost is the actual rect count not the cap, so headroom is free. Helps the compiled game too (world_loader clamps to the same MAX_RECTS → less collider windowing). Zig change → needs a dev-host rebuild AND a compiled rebuild to take effect (NOT a hot-reload). ast-check clean on physics.zig + world_loader.zig. Very large maps will still need spatial windowing in /test eventually (compiled already has it) — noted, not done here.
